radius_mm.label: Radius of Curvature
radius_mm.short: Spherical radius of the surface. R>0 puts the center of curvature on the +X side, R<0 on the -X side. R=0 denotes a flat surface.
radius_mm.long: This engine treats radius_mm=0 as a flat surface (equivalent to the conventional infinity). The UI displays flats as infinity while storing and sending 0. For optimization, using curvature c=1/R as the variable is more stable when a surface may cross through flat.

curvature.label: Curvature
curvature.short: Reciprocal of the radius, c=1/R. c=0 is a flat surface and the recommended variable space for optimization.

conic.label: Conic Constant
conic.short: Constant k defining a conic section surface. k=0: sphere, k=-1: paraboloid, k<-1: hyperboloid, -1<k<0: prolate ellipsoid.

asphere_coefficients.label: Aspheric Coefficients
asphere_coefficients.short: Even-order aspheric terms A4, A6, A8… added as polynomial departure from the base conic surface.
asphere_coefficients.long: Aspheres are powerful for correcting spherical aberration and coma, but large coefficients can destabilize the iterative intersection solve. If marginal rays fail with numerical_error, review the coefficients and clear aperture.

thickness_after_mm.label: Thickness After
thickness_after_mm.short: Distance from this surface vertex to the next along the propagation path. Negative after a mirror reflection.

material.label: Material
material.short: Medium following this surface: AIR, a catalog glass, or a Sellmeier definition.

semi_diameter_mm.label: Semi-Diameter
semi_diameter_mm.short: Radius of the clear aperture. Rays beyond it are blocked.

aperture_stop.label: Aperture Stop
aperture_stop.short: The stop that limits the axial beam. Exactly one per system; it defines the pupils, F-number, and the ray-aiming target.
aperture_stop.long: Stop position strongly affects the aberration balance (notably coma, distortion, lateral color) and relative illumination. Moving the stop and watching the aberration plots change is an instructive exercise.

annulus.label: Annular Aperture
annulus.short: Ring-shaped aperture with a central obstruction, used to model a reflector's secondary mirror shadow.

thin_lens.label: Ideal Thin Lens
thin_lens.short: Zero-thickness idealized lens defined only by its focal length; for teaching and quick studies.

sensor.label: Sensor
sensor.short: Image-recording plane; the terminal element of a focal system.

eye_reference.label: Eye Reference
eye_reference.short: Terminal element of an afocal system, representing a virtual eye pupil where the angular image is evaluated.

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.short: Reflecting surface. Propagation reverses after it; subsequent thicknesses are written negative.

propagation_sign.label: Propagation Sign
propagation_sign.short: Internal flag telling whether a ray travels toward +X (+1) or -X (-1); flips at each mirror.

field.label: Field
field.short: Object-side direction or position; for infinite objects, given as angles (θy, θz).

chief_ray.label: Chief Ray
chief_ray.short: Ray from the object point through the center of the aperture stop; reference for image height, distortion, and CRA.

marginal_ray.label: Marginal Ray
marginal_ray.short: Ray from the axial object point through the stop edge; sets the F-number and reveals spherical aberration.

entrance_pupil.label: Entrance Pupil
entrance_pupil.short: Image of the aperture stop seen from object space; the apparent aperture the light enters.

exit_pupil.label: Exit Pupil
exit_pupil.short: Image of the stop seen from the image (eye) side. In binoculars it sets where and how large the eye's pupil should be.
exit_pupil.long: Exit pupil diameter = objective aperture / magnification. Smaller than the eye's pupil (2-3 mm in daylight, 5-7 mm in the dark) the view dims; larger and light is wasted. Together with eye relief it determines viewing comfort.

ray_aiming.label: Ray Aiming
ray_aiming.short: Iterative adjustment of launch direction so each ray passes through its intended point on the stop; essential for wide-angle and decentered systems.

pupil_sampling.label: Pupil Sampling
pupil_sampling.short: How the ray bundle is distributed over the pupil: hexapolar for analysis, gaussian_quadrature for accurate few-ray optimization, etc.

paraxial.label: Paraxial
paraxial.short: First-order approximation near the axis; EFL, pupils, and image locations are defined from it.

effective_focal_length.label: Effective Focal Length (EFL)
effective_focal_length.short: Focal length of the whole system; the primary spec determining field of view and image scale.

back_focal_length.label: Back Focal Length (BFL)
back_focal_length.short: Distance from the last surface to the paraxial image; a key packaging constraint.

f_number.label: F-Number
f_number.short: EFL divided by entrance pupil diameter. Lower is brighter but harder to correct.

sellmeier.label: Sellmeier Equation
sellmeier.short: Standard dispersion formula giving a glass's refractive index versus wavelength.

abbe_number.label: Abbe Number (Vd)
abbe_number.short: Measure of low dispersion; higher means less chromatic spread. Crowns are high, flints low.

wavelength_FdC.label: F, d, C Lines
wavelength_FdC.short: Standard wavelengths: F 486 nm (blue), d 588 nm (yellow), C 656 nm (red); thereference set for chromatic evaluation.

zoom_group.label: Zoom Group
zoom_group.short: Lens group translated along the axis to change focal length.

focus_group.label: Focus Group
focus_group.short: Lens group moved to focus the system.

decenter.label: Decenter (Shift)
decenter.short: Lateral (Y/Z) displacement of surfaces or groups; models image stabilization and tolerances.

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.short: Rotation of surfaces or groups about a pivot; introduces image-plane tilt and asymmetric aberrations.

afocal.label: Afocal System
afocal.short: System taking collimated light to collimated light (binoculars, telescope with eyepiece); evaluated in angle, not position.

spot_diagram.label: Spot Diagram
spot_diagram.short: Pattern of ray intersections on the sensor from a single object point; an intuitive picture of aberrations.
spot_diagram.long: Tighter clusters mean sharper images. The shape is diagnostic: comet-like flare indicates coma, direction-dependent elongation astigmatism, wavelength-dependent offsets chromatic aberration.

rms_spot_radius.label: RMS Spot Radius
rms_spot_radius.short: Root-mean-square radius of the spot about its centroid; smaller is sharper.

encircled_energy_radius.label: Encircled Energy Radius
encircled_energy_radius.short: Radius of the circle containing a given fraction (e.g. 80%) of the energy.

ray_fan.label: Ray Fan
ray_fan.short: Transverse aberration plotted against pupil coordinate; the curve shape identifies each aberration type.
ray_fan.long: Slope means defocus, an S-curve spherical aberration, asymmetry coma, and a difference between the tangential and sagittal fans astigmatism. It is the designer's first diagnostic plot.

longitudinal_aberration.label: Longitudinal Aberration
longitudinal_aberration.short: Axial focus shift versus pupil height. In one wavelength it mainly shows spherical aberration; overlaid wavelengths also show axial chromatic aberration.

spherical_aberration.label: Spherical Aberration
spherical_aberration.short: Focus error growing with pupil height; rays through the pupil edge focus at a different depth. Stopping down reduces it.

coma.label: Coma
coma.short: Off-axis aberration smearing point images into comet shapes; sensitive to stop position and symmetry.

astigmatism.label: Astigmatism
astigmatism.short: Different focus for tangential and sagittal ray fans, seen as the separation of the M and S image surfaces.

field_curvature.label: Field Curvature
field_curvature.short: Curvature of the best-focus surface; the periphery defocuses on a flat sensor.

ms_image_surface.label: M/S Image Surfaces
ms_image_surface.short: Best-focus surfaces for meridional (M) and sagittal (S) fans; their separation quantifies astigmatism.

distortion.label: Distortion
distortion.short: Departure of image height from the ideal f·tan(θ): pincushion (+) or barrel (−). It warps geometry without blurring.

axial_color.label: Axial (Longitudinal) Chromatic Aberration
axial_color.short: Wavelength-dependent shift of focus along the axis.

lateral_color.label: Lateral Chromatic Aberration
lateral_color.short: Wavelength-dependent image height (magnification), seen as color fringing toward the field edge.

psf.label: Point Spread Function (PSF)
psf.short: Intensity pattern a point source forms on the image plane. The initial version is geometric (ray-density based, no diffraction).

mtf.label: MTF
mtf.short: Contrast transfer versus spatial frequency; the standard measure of resolving performance.
mtf.long: Frequency in lp/mm, response from 0 to 1. Low frequencies relate to contrast, high frequencies to fine detail. Geometric MTF omits diffraction, so it is optimistic at high F-numbers and high frequencies.

relative_illumination.label: Relative Illumination
relative_illumination.short: Image brightness versus field, normalized to 100% on axis; falls off via vignetting and the cos⁴ law.

vignetting.label: Vignetting
vignetting.short: Blocking of off-axis beams by apertures other than the stop (lens rims, barrel).

cos4_law.label: Cosine-Fourth Law
cos4_law.short: Even without vignetting, oblique-beam geometry alone reduces illumination as cos⁴θ.

chief_ray_angle.label: Chief Ray Angle (CRA)
chief_ray_angle.short: Angle at which the chief ray meets the sensor; must match the sensor's microlens design.

edge_thickness.label: Edge Thickness
edge_thickness.short: Thickness at the lens rim (vertex gap adjusted by sag). Negative or tiny values are unmanufacturable.

total_track_length.label: Total Track Length
total_track_length.short: Overall length from the first surface to the image plane; a compactness metric.

evaluation_plane.label: Evaluation Plane
evaluation_plane.short: Virtual plane where spot/PSF/MTF are computed; movable independently of the physical sensor.

best_focus.label: Best Focus
best_focus.short: Image-plane position optimizing a chosen criterion (min RMS, max MTF, etc.).

image_plane_policy.label: Image Plane Policy
image_plane_policy.short: How the evaluation plane is chosen: fixed sensor, paraxial image, best focus, sweep, etc.

operand.label: Operand
operand.short: One optimization item: a metric with its field/wavelength, target, and tolerance.

residual.label: Residual
residual.short: (value − target)/tolerance; equals 1 when off by one tolerance. Optimization minimizes the sum of squares.

merit.label: Merit Function
merit.short: Sum of squared residuals plus penalties; lower is better.

magnification.label: Magnification
magnification.short: Angular magnification of a telescope or binocular: objective focal length over eyepiece focal length.

true_field_of_view.label: True Field of View
true_field_of_view.short: Object-side angular extent visible without moving the instrument.

apparent_field_of_view.label: Apparent Field of View
apparent_field_of_view.short: Angular width of the view as perceived through the eyepiece.

eye_relief.label: Eye Relief
eye_relief.short: Distance from the last eyepiece surface to the exit pupil; longer is friendlier to eyeglass wearers.

eye_box.label: Eye Box
eye_box.short: Tolerance volume for eye placement before the view degrades; a small one causes frequent blackouts.

blackout.label: Blackout
blackout.short: Partial or total darkening of the view when the eye moves off the exit pupil.

diopter.label: Diopter
diopter.short: Vergence in 1/m; the unit for residual focus error of an afocal system.

angular_mtf.label: Angular MTF
angular_mtf.short: MTF of an afocal system, expressed in cycles per degree of the apparent field.

central_obstruction.label: Central Obstruction
central_obstruction.short: Blocking of the central beam by a reflector's secondary mirror; affects contrast and throughput.

collimation.label: Collimation
collimation.short: Parallelism of the two optical axes of a binocular; misalignment prevents image fusion and causes strain.

negative_air_gap.label: Negative Air Gap
negative_air_gap.message: Air gap between {surface_ids} is negative ({gap_mm} mm).
negative_air_gap.action: Review the group positions or thickness_after_mm.

group_overlap.label: Group Overlap
group_overlap.message: Groups {group_ids} overlap after the applied motion.

missing_aperture_stop.label: Missing Aperture Stop
missing_aperture_stop.message: The system has no aperture stop; exactly one is required.
missing_aperture_stop.action: Designate one surface as the aperture stop.

aiming_failed.label: Ray Aiming Failed
aiming_failed.message: Ray aiming failed to converge for {count} rays ({ratio}%).
aiming_failed.action: Likely extreme field angles or decentering. Check them; the affected rays are excluded from statistics.

total_internal_reflection.label: Total Internal Reflection
total_internal_reflection.message: Some rays underwent total internal reflection.
total_internal_reflection.action: Incidence exceeds the critical angle; check curvatures, glasses, and field angles.

no_valid_rays.label: No Valid Rays
no_valid_rays.action: Check clear apertures, stop size, and field angles.

solve_not_converged.label: Solve Not Converged
solve_not_converged.message: The focus solve did not converge within the range; the range-end value is returned.
solve_not_converged.action: Widen range_mm or verify the system forms an image.

artifact_expired.label: Artifact Expired
artifact_expired.action: Re-run the analysis. Results you need to keep are embedded in snapshots.

infeasible.label: Infeasible Configuration
infeasible.message: This configuration is physically invalid; tracing was skipped.
infeasible.action: Fix each item listed in violations.

radius_key_deprecated.label: Radius Key Deprecated
radius_key_deprecated.action: It is unstable near flat surfaces; prefer the curvature key.
